### Query Sequence and error tolerance

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/results/V600-Cluster-DB26Feb24.csv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)

query_seq <- "YADWGLYGDFDDY"
rate <- 0.4
```

### Iterate over files, querying

```{r}
results <- data.frame()

for (f in files){
  cat("Loading:", f, '\n')
  tmp <- read.csv(paste(root_dir, f, sep = ''), 
                  header = T, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = '\t')
  # Tag it
  tmp$f <- rep(f, each = nrow(tmp))
  # Elevator music
  cat("Querying for:", query_seq, '\n')
  # Pre-process loaded data
  tmp$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(tmp$junction_aa)
  # Store the resulting distances
  tmp$query_dist <- as.vector(adist(query_seq, tmp$junction_aa))
  # Convert distance to homology
  tmp$homology <- 1 - (tmp$query_dist/nchar(query_seq))
  # Demand homology and sequence length
  # tmp_frame 
  tmp_frame <- tmp[tmp$homology >= rate,]
  # Demand identical sequence length
  tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[nchar(tmp_frame$consensus_sequence) == nchar(query_seq),]
  # rbind results
  results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
}
```































## Load Data

```{r}
df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/results/V600-Cluster-DB26Feb24.csv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

### Query Aggregate Databases

First, we parallelize the computations.

```{r}
library(parallel)

# Set the number of cores to use in parallel
num_cores <- detectCores()

# Define Query Sequence id
query_seq <- "YADWGLYGDFDDY"

# Perform parallel computation of Levenshtein distances
cl <- makeCluster(num_cores)
clusterExport(cl, c("query_seq", "df"))
distances <- parSapply(cl, df$consensus_sequence, calculate_levenshtein, query_seq)
stopCluster(cl)

# Store the resulting distances
df$query_dist <- distances

# Percent similarity
df$percent_sim <- 1 - (distances/nchar(query_seq))
```

### Iterate over percent cutoffs, merging data

**We are interested in YADWGLYGDFDDY, at 50% of homology.**

```
f_vals <- c("13_VecF1_R2_S13_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "14_VecF1_R2_S14_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "15_VecF3_R2_S15_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "16_VecF4_R2_S16_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "20_VecF2_R3_S20_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",
            "21_VecF4_R3_S21_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv")
```

```{r}
error_tolerance <- 0.5#seq(1, 0.1, -0.1)

res_frame <- data.frame()

for (rate in error_tolerance){
  # Subset based on similarity
  tmp_frame <- df[df$percent_sim >= rate,]
  # Demand identical lengths
  tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[nchar(tmp_frame$consensus_sequence) == nchar(query_seq),]
  # Store cutoff value
  tmp_frame$cutoff <- rep(rate, each = nrow(tmp_frame))
  res_frame <- rbind(res_frame, tmp_frame)
}

# Drop any runs we are not interested in
res_frame <- res_frame[(res_frame$f %in% f_vals),]

res_frame <- res_frame[order(res_frame$cutoff, res_frame$percent_sim, decreasing = T),]
```

## Load Data, Align Sequences, etc.

Now that we have subset clones within some % homology, we will load all clonal families and, for each, we will create:

1. Sequence Alignments **Bonus: order by similarity to consensus**

2. Logo Plots

```
data_dir <- "~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs"
res_dir <- "~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/cluster_database"

files <- list.files(data_dir)[grepl(".tsv", list.files(data_dir))]
```


```{r}
root_dir <- "~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/clean_results/"

results <- data.frame()

# Iterate over files
for (file_name in unique(res_frame$f)){
  # Load the VHH database
  tmp <- read.csv(paste(root_dir, file_name, sep = ''), sep = '\t', header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
  
  # iterate over thresholds
  for (threshold in unique(res_frame$cutoff)){
    tmp_frame <- res_frame[res_frame$f == file_name & res_frame$cutoff == threshold,
                           c("f", "consensus_sequence", "cluster_id", "cutoff")]
    colnames(tmp_frame) <- c("f", "consensus_sequence", "clone_id", "cutoff")
    
    # Pull all clones by merging
    tmp_frame <- merge(tmp, tmp_frame, by = "clone_id")
    # Dist nearest isn't defined on all
    tmp_frame$dist_nearest <- NULL
    print(file_name)
    print(colnames(tmp_frame))
    # Bind results
    results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
  }
  
  # Subset only clones of interest
}
```

## Cleanup for Presentation

1. Trim CDR3s

2. Translate VHHs

3. Drop unproductive sequences

```{r}
results$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(results$junction_aa)

distances <- as.vector(adist(results$junction_aa, query_seq))

# Store the resulting distances
#results$query_dist <- distances

# Percent similarity
results$percent_sim_to_query <- 1 - (distances/nchar(query_seq))

# VHHs
results$VHH <- translate_DNA(results$sequence_alignment)

# take passes, drop fails
fails <- results[which(grepl("\\*", results$VHH, fixed = F)),]
nrow(fails)
pass <- results[which(!grepl("\\*", results$VHH, fixed = F)),]
nrow(pass)

## Drop the first 10 amino acids
pass$VHH <- substr(pass$VHH, 11, nchar(pass$VHH))
```

## Align and Order by cutoff, and save

```{r}
res_out <- list()
counter <- 1

for (threshold in unique(pass$cutoff)){
  tmp_frame <- pass[pass$cutoff == threshold,]
  sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(tmp_frame$VHH)
  # Perform multiple sequence alignment
  msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", order = "input")
  # Store aligned results
  tmp_frame$Aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
  res_out[[counter]] <- tmp_frame
  counter <- counter + 1
}
```


```{r}
for (i in 1:length(res_out)){
  tmp_frame <- res_out[[i]]
  tmp_frame$query_seq <- rep(query_seq, each = nrow(tmp_frame))

                "percent_sim_to_query",
                "cutoff",
                "Aligned_VHHs")]
```

## Cluster Database Queries

### Query Clonal Databases

Load `df` as the derived consensus sequence database.

```{r}
library(airr)
library(shazam)
library(ggtree)

df <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/results/V600-Cluster-DB26Feb24.csv",
               header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

### Query Clonal Consensus Sequences

We will query the aggregate clonal database for consensus sequences with close matches.

```{r}
# Specify query sequence
query_seq <- "YADWGLYGDFDDY"

# Store the resulting distances
df$query_dist <- as.vector(adist(query_seq, df$consensus_sequence))

df$percent_sim <- 1 - (df$query_dist/nchar(query_seq))

rate <- 0.6

# tmp_frame 
tmp_frame <- df[df$percent_sim >= rate,]

# Demand identical sequence length
tmp_frame <- tmp_frame[nchar(tmp_frame$consensus_sequence) == nchar(query_seq),]
```

Now that we have the clones whose consensus sequences is within 50% of the consensus of our query sequence, we can load the data from the databases (Illumina Runs), and begin to hierarchically cluster from there.

## Pull Identified Clonal Groups

```{r}
root_dir <- "~/VHH/data/Cluster-DBs/clean_results/"

results <- data.frame()

failed_res <- list()
counter <- 1

for (f in unique(tmp_frame$f)){
  tmp <- tmp_frame[tmp_frame$f == f,]
  # Pull observations from the database itself
  db <- read_rearrangement(paste(root_dir, f, sep = ''))
  # Subset clones of interest (specific to the file)
  db <- db[db$clone_id %in% tmp$cluster_id,]
  # Keep file name
  db$f <- rep(f, each = nrow(db))
  print(f)
  print(head(db))
  if (ncol(db) == 55){
      # rbind data to results
      results <- rbind(results, db)
  } else {
    cat("The following database may be missing dist_nearest values:\n")
    cat(f, '\n')
    #failed_res[[counter]] <- db
    #counter <- counter + 1
    db <- distToNearest(db, model = "ham", normalize = "len", 
                      vCallColumn = "v_call", 
                      jCallColumn = "j_call",
                      nproc = 4)
    results <- rbind(results, db)
  }

}

results$junction_aa <- trim_CDR3(results$junction_aa)
```


## Calculate file, clone-level statistics

First, paste run_id to clone_id for disambiguation

```{r}
results$f <- gsub("_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv", '', results$f)

results$clone_id <- paste(results$f, '-', results$clone_id, sep = '')

```

Like below


```{r}
dat <- results

tmp_res <- data.frame()

for (nm in unique(results$clone_id)){
  # Subset the clones of interest
  tmp_frame <- dat[dat$clone_id == nm,]
  # Pull cluster id
  cluster_id <- nm
  ## Note: here we need to ensure that we account for the 
  # Duplicate count
  unrolled_CDR3s <- unroll_dupes_fast(tmp_frame, "junction_aa")
  
  # Make consensus sequence
  consensus_sequence <- strict_consensus(unrolled_CDR3s)
  
  # Calculate entropy
  CDR3_entropy <- string_entropy(unrolled_CDR3s)
  
  # Sum duplicate count for the number of TOTAL DNA seqs
  Dup_count <- sum(tmp_frame$duplicate_count)
  # Unique DNA sequences
  DNA_seqs_in_cluster <- length(unique(tmp_frame$sequence))
  # Unique CDR3s
  CDR3s_in_cluster <- length(unique(tmp_frame$junction_aa))
  
  # Bind results
  tmp_res <- rbind(tmp_res, cbind(f,
                                  cluster_id,
                                  consensus_sequence,
                                  Dup_count,
                                  DNA_seqs_in_cluster,
                                  CDR3s_in_cluster,
                                  CDR3_entropy))

}

# f is meaningless here
tmp_res$f <- NULL

tmp_res$clone_id <- gsub("^[^-]*-", "", tmp_res$cluster_id)
tmp_res$f <-  gsub("-.*$", "", tmp_res$cluster_id)

rm(db, tmp_frame)
```

Write summary

```{r}
write.csv(tmp_res, file = "~/Downloads/YADWGLYGDFDDY-Clonal-family-summary-stats-CDR3-17Mar24.csv", row.names = F)
```

## Format Clones

Before trees can be built, data must be formatted into a data table of AIRR clone objects. This is accomplished using the formatClones function. This function will:

1. Change non-nucleotide characters to N characters.

2. By default, collapse sequences that are either identical or differ only by ambiguous characters.

3. Sequences will not be collapsed if they differ by columns specified in the traits option, or if the `collapse` option is set to `FALSE`.

4. Include data columns specified by num_fields or text_fields.

5. Remove uninformative sequence sites in which all sequences have N characters.

```{r}
# Process example data keeping samples from different times
# distinct, adding duplicate_count among collapsed sequences,
# and show the sample_id within each clone in the tibble.
clones <- formatClones(results, traits=c("junction_aa"),
    # num_fields=c("duplicate_count"), 
    columns=c("f"))

print(clones)
```


```{r}
# Add tree info
clones <- getTrees(clones, nproc=4)
```

# Clonal Consensus Cluster Dendrograms (Non-Hierarchical)

35in seems to work for width with portrait orientation

Note: Complete Linkage: Merges clusters based on the maximum pairwise dissimilarity.

```{r}
# Install and load necessary packages
#install.packages("stringdist")
library(stringdist)

strings <- df[df$f == "19_VecF1_R3_S19_min_threshold_clone-pass.tsv",]$consensus_sequence

strings <- strings[!duplicated(strings)]

# strings <- strings[nchar(strings) < 20]

# Compute the distance matrix using Jaccard distance
dist_matrix <- stringdistmatrix(strings, method = "jaccard")

# Perform hierarchical clustering
cluster_tree <- hclust(as.dist(dist_matrix), method = "complete")

# Plot the dendrogram with labels
plot(cluster_tree, main = "Cluster Dendrogram of 19_VecF1_R3_S19\nDistance Metric: Jaccard Similarity", xlab = "Clonal Family Consensus CDR3s", sub = NULL, labels = strings, ylab = "Distance (Jaccard Similarity)")
```
